flaws.description: Replaced the true chart title with a factually wrong one referencing a different metric (maternal mortality reduction) and time period (2010 vs 2020) instead of urban/rural skilled birth attendance.

Changed the Rural_Skilled_Birth_Attendance value for Federated States of Micronesia from 85.0 to 38.3 (85.0 * 0.45), making that single bar much shorter while the table still lists the true 85.0 value.
